name: Genkai OL Umi e Iku
source:
Tidal Therapy is a travel novel game for tired adults. A tired office worker heads to the sea. The setting is a quiet and beautiful sea town with a seaside park, warehouse district, and tower condominiums.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635530]Steam[/url]]
